summary_en: HYUGA PRIMARY CARE will launch a self-tender offer to acquire 646,928 shares (8.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) held by M3 Group and CUC following completion of an MBO-structured take-private transaction. The self-tender offer is contingent on successful completion of a third-party tender offer by JG44, expected to settle on November 17, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Plans for Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Public Tender Offer for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
HYUGA PRIMARY CARE announced on September 25, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to conduct a public tender offer to acquire treasury stock. Specifically, the company plans to acquire 646,928 shares held by M3 Group (comprising M3 Inc. and M3 Career Inc.) and CUC Inc., representing 8.71% of outstanding shares (calculated by dividing the target shares by 7,427,072 shares, which is the total issued shares of 7,279,000 as of June 30, 2026, plus 295,200 shares underlying outstanding warrants, less 147,128 treasury shares held by the company).

This acquisition is part of a two-stage transaction to take the company private in an MBO structure. The acquirer is JG44 Inc., which was established on September 4, 2026, and is wholly owned by JGIA Fund 3, managed by Japan Growth Investment Alliance Inc. JG44 is conducting a public tender offer for all of the company's shares and warrants, with settlement expected to commence on November 17, 2026. The company's president and largest shareholder, Tetsushi Kuroki (holding 18.27% of shares), will continue to manage the company following the transaction.

The self-tender offer by the company will commence on November 18, 2026 (the business day after the third-party tender offer settles) and is conditional on all conditions precedent being satisfied, including successful completion of the third-party tender offer. The company did not disclose a maximum acquisition price or specific end date for the self-tender offer.
